name: kohlab
description: Self-hosted agent workspace console. One VPS, N safe users: named members get OS-isolated workspaces, agents run in a PTY cockpit (terminal / files / diff / log), owners manage team + audit. No database, no containers.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with shadcn-style CSS variables
stack.uiPrimitives: Radix Dialog (only Radix primitive in use)

theme.palette: carbon-black neutrals, emerald primary, amber warning, red destructive
theme.typography: JetBrains Mono / ui-monospace for UI; 16px root, 14px control floor

visualLanguage.posture: dense but breathable, no skeuomorphism, no decorative gradients
visualLanguage.statusSemantics: emerald pulse = running, amber = finished (done), neutral zinc = stopped; red = destructive only
visualLanguage.brandMark: glowing emerald dot (as in the auth gate and sidebar), no image logo

pillars: progressive disclosure (confirms on destructive, onboarding only first-run)

views.dashboard: Command center: KPI cards, activity feed, agent availability
views.workspaces: onboarding wizard when empty, else workspace cockpit

avoid: route rearchitecture - zustand views stay as-is
depsThatMayBeAdded: framer-motion only if a picked component requires it (respect reduced-motion)
